name: Beware Of Bear

features.name: Wild Swipe Respins
features.description: The bear swipes wilds into place.

review:
Beware Of Bear is a 6x4 camping slot with 20 fixed paylines. Wilds and special wilds feed the Wild Swipe Respins feature, where the bear's paws push the action along, and expanding beehive wilds add more.

Thunderkick rates it High volatility, with a 10,000x cap. The published RTP is 94.29%.
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
